summary: TEILEKLAR Phase 1 E2E (backend pytest 20 tests via public URL + Playwright UI). 19/20 backend passed. Only failure: anonymous GET /api/admin/settings returns 403 instead of the expected 401. UI: public pages, register/duplicate/short-password, login/wrong-password, UI logout, lockout (API), forgot-password, Google redirect (went through auth.emergentagent.com to accounts.google.com, not completed), shop/categories empty states, guest cart empty, workshop finder (14547 -> 8 results, map, detail, 00000 zero state), admin settings (35 saved and persisted, restored to 30), import panel with run history and failure reasons, customer admin-denied all pass.

minor.issue: Returns 403 admin_required for an unauthenticated request, but the spec expects 401. Root cause: shop/auth.py require_admin only checks ident.role != 'admin' and never tells a missing session apart from the wrong role.
Check-then-insert race: two parallel registrations with the same email hit the unique index, raising DuplicateKeyError -> 500. Catch pymongo DuplicateKeyError and return 409.
Once RESEND is configured, an httpx network exception isn't caught, so the endpoint returns 500 and the response is no longer generic. Wrap the call in try/except.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Diese E-Mail-Adresse ist bereits registriert' shows twice: as the field error (auth-email-error) and again as the alert (auth-error), because both e.fields and body.message get set.

passed_tests: Shop catalog-empty and categories-empty states shown, no crash
Guest cart-empty shown; POST /api/shop/cart/items with nonexistent product -> 404; qty 99 -> 422
Register via UI -> redirected to /teileklar/bestellungen, /api/auth/me 200, header shows 'Abmelden (email)'
Short password -> field error 'Das Passwort muss mindestens 10 Zeichen lang sein.'
Duplicate email -> 409 'Diese E-Mail-Adresse ist bereits registriert'
Wrong password -> 'E-Mail oder Passwort ist falsch' (UI and API)
Logout (UI button and API) -> /api/auth/me 401 using the old token
Lockout: 5 failures on a throwaway email -> 6th attempt with the correct password returns 429
Forgot password -> generic message for existing and unknown emails
Google button visible and redirects via auth.emergentagent.com
Workshop q=14547 -> 8 results, Leaflet map, detail page TKW-DE-000109 opens; q=00000 -> workshop-no-results; unknown id -> 404
Admin: markup 30, VAT 19; 35 saved and persisted after reload, restored to 30; invalid markup 'abc' -> 422
Admin import panel: ftp/api/sandbox buttons, run history 'ftp_login_incorrect' / 'access_denied' with 'bisheriger Katalog bleibt erhalten', active products 0; invalid environment -> 422
Customer: /api/admin/settings 403 and the UI shows admin-denied
action_items: In shop/auth.py require_admin: raise 401 {'error':'authentication_required'} when ident.user_id is None, and 403 only when the role is wrong
Wrap the Resend httpx call in try/except in forgot-password
AuthForms: don't show the alert when the same text already shows as a field error (duplicate email)
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout counts failures per email, so anyone can lock the admin account for 15 minutes with 5 bad attempts (account-level DoS). Consider IP+email keys or a CAPTCHA.
google_session links an existing password account by email without the user confirming. This is acceptable because Google verifies the email, but it should be a deliberate decision.
logout only invalidates the session from the cookie; a Bearer-header session can't be logged out.
Guest cart merge couldn't be tested end-to-end because there are 0 products. The code reads correctly (find_one_and_delete on the guest cart, quantities capped at 20).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 low cosmetic issue)

seed_data_creation: Several throwaway customer accounts qa+<hex>@example.org were created; some are locked by the lockout test (expire after 15 min). Admin markup was restored to 30.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: PREVIEW_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://chat-it-automate--01quzkxh.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_teileklar_phase1.py. frontend/.env has no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; use PREVIEW_PUBLIC_ORIGIN from backend env. Cart add endpoint is /api/shop/cart/items. Product detail, checkout and cart merge with real products are untested (no catalog because BigBuy credentials fail).
rca of the issue: Anonymous gets 403: auth.require_admin calls identity(), which returns Identity(None, None, guest) for anonymous users; role None != 'admin' -> 403. Fix: check user_id first.
